user.title: Add a paperlesspaper frame
user.description: Enter the ID shown on the frame's screen (for example `epd7-3485188f1dc8`).

data_description.url_host: Which of Home Assistant's addresses goes into the frame's URLs. Automatic uses Home Assistant's local network URL. Pick another IP if Home Assistant is reachable on several networks, or type an IP or hostname the frame can resolve (no .local names).

urls.title: Point the frame at Home Assistant
urls.description:
In the official paperlesspaper web UI, set:

**Settings URL:** `{settings_url}`

**Image URL:** `{image_url}`

The frame must be able to reach Home Assistant at this address over plain HTTP.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Set up {client_id}
bluetooth_confirm.description: Home Assistant will configure the frame over Bluetooth to fetch its pictures from `{base_url}`. Keep the frame in setup mode (press its button once).

data.name: Name
data.provision: Configure the frame over Bluetooth now

wifi.name: WiFi (optional)
wifi.description: Set the frame's WiFi network, e.g. for a new frame. Leave empty to keep its current network.

data_description.url_host: Which of Home Assistant's addresses goes into the frame's URLs. Automatic uses Home Assistant's local network URL. Pick another IP if Home Assistant is reachable on several networks, or type an IP or hostname the frame can resolve (no .local names).

error.invalid_client_id: This doesn't look like a frame ID (epd7-… or epd13- followed by 12 hex digits).
error.provision_failed: Couldn't configure the frame over Bluetooth. Press its button once and try again, or untick the option to set it up manually.
error.wifi_failed: The frame couldn't join that WiFi network. Check the name and password, press the frame's button once, and try again.
error.invalid_host: Enter an IP address or hostname, without http:// or a port.
error.unusable_host: The frame can't use this address (loopback, localhost or a .local name). Choose a LAN IP address.

abort.already_configured: This frame is already set up.
abort.no_internal_url: Home Assistant has no local network URL. Set one under Settings → System → Network.
abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device isn't a supported frame.

init.title: Frame settings
init.description:
In the official paperlesspaper web UI, set:

**Settings URL:** `{settings_url}`

**Image URL:** `{image_url}`

The frame must be able to reach Home Assistant at this address over plain HTTP.

data.ble_auto: Update over Bluetooth in setup mode

data_description.interval: How long the frame sleeps between updates (minutes). Applied at its next wake.
data_description.mounting: How the frame hangs on the wall.
data_description.regenerate_token: The old URLs stop working immediately. Afterwards, press the frame's button once and Home Assistant updates it over Bluetooth (or use the repair notice).
data_description.ble_auto: When you press the frame's button once, Home Assistant connects briefly to read battery and charging status and to send pending changes. Turn off if you use the official web UI at the same time.
data_description.url_host: Which of Home Assistant's addresses goes into the frame's URLs. Automatic uses Home Assistant's local network URL. Pick another IP if Home Assistant is reachable on several networks, or type an IP or hostname the frame can resolve (no .local names). After changing it, press the frame's button once so Home Assistant can give it the new URLs.

quiet_hours.name: Quiet hours
quiet_hours.description: The frame sleeps through quiet hours instead of updating.

data.quiet_suppress_motion: Disable motion wake-up during quiet hours

rendering.name: Rendering defaults for this frame
rendering.description: Overrides the global defaults; photos can override these again.

data_description.brightness: Leave empty to use the global default.
data_description.contrast: Leave empty to use the global default.
data_description.saturation: Leave empty to use the global default.

authentication.name: HTTP authentication
authentication.description: Require HTTP Basic credentials for the image URL. They are sent to the frame on its next wake.

error.auth_incomplete: Enter both a username and a password.
error.invalid_host: Enter an IP address or hostname, without http:// or a port.
error.unusable_host: The frame can't use this address (loopback, localhost or a .local name). Choose a LAN IP address.

options.bluetooth: Over Bluetooth (press the frame's button once first)
options.manual: I've entered the URLs in the web UI myself

options.change: Every wake when the text changed

offline.title: {name} hasn't checked in
offline.description: The frame {name} last contacted Home Assistant at {last_seen} and has missed several updates. Check that it has power (or battery) and WiFi, and that it can reach Home Assistant. Pressing its button twice forces an update. This notice disappears by itself once the frame checks in again.

init.title: Update {name}'s URLs
init.description:
To update over Bluetooth, press the button on {name} once (it then stays in setup mode for about 30 seconds) and select Submit. A Bluetooth adapter or proxy must be near the frame.

Or enter these in the official web UI:

**Settings URL:** `{settings_url}`

**Image URL:** `{image_url}`

error.not_found: The frame wasn't found over Bluetooth. Press its button once and try again.
error.ble_failed: Couldn't update the frame over Bluetooth. Press its button once and try again.
error.no_bluetooth: Bluetooth isn't set up in Home Assistant.
error.no_url: Home Assistant has no local network URL. Set one under Settings → System → Network.
